description: Deploy and manage apps on your own AppCrane instance, the self-hosted PaaS for AI-built apps.
name: io.github.gitayg/appcrane

environmentVariables.description: Base URL of your own AppCrane instance, e.g. https://crane.example.com. Without it the connector still starts and answers tools/list from the bundled catalog, but cannot execute tools.
environmentVariables.name: APPCRANE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Your AppCrane API key, sent to the instance as the X-API-Key header. Required to execute tools.
environmentVariables.name: APPCRANE_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Optional GitHub personal access token, sent as X-Github-Token, to unlock the github_* passthrough tools.
environmentVariables.name: APPCRANE_GITHUB_TOKEN

title: AppCrane
